topic: Deep Learning: CNNs for Image Recognition & RNNs for Sequence Data

questions.scenario: Real-world Industrial Problem Statement: An e-commerce company is developing an image recognition system to categorize products based on images. The dataset contains 100,000 images of various products, but 80% of the images are of electronic devices, while the remaining 20% are of other products like clothing, home goods, etc.
questions.question: What approach should be taken to handle the class imbalance in the dataset for better CNN model performance?
options: B) Use class weighting during training
C) Use transfer learning with pre-trained models
D) Collect more data for the minority class
questions.correct_answer_text: B) Use class weighting during training
questions.explanation: Class weighting during training helps to assign more weight to the minority class, which can help the model to generalize better on the minority class. This approach is particularly useful when there is a significant class imbalance in the dataset.

questions.scenario: Real-world Industrial Problem Statement: A chatbot is being developed to predict the next word in a sentence based on the context of the conversation. The chatbot uses RNNs to model the sequence data. However, the model is taking too long to respond to user queries due to the high dimensionality of the input data.
questions.question: What technique can be employed to reduce the dimensionality of the input data and improve the response time of the chatbot?
options: D) Using a smaller RNN model with fewer layers
questions.explanation: Word2Vec is a word embedding technique that can reduce the dimensionality of the input data by representing words as vectors in a lower dimensional space. This can significantly reduce the computational cost and improve the response time of the chatbot.

questions.scenario: Real-world Industrial Problem Statement: A self-driving car is being developed to recognize and respond to traffic signals in real-time. The car uses a CNN-based system to recognize traffic signals. However, the system is experiencing difficulty in recognizing traffic signals at night or in low light conditions due to the poor quality of the input images.
questions.question: What approach can be taken to improve the performance of the CNN-based system in low light conditions?
options: A) Collect more data for the minority class (low light conditions)
B) Use image preprocessing techniques like histogram equalization
C) Use data augmentation techniques like random brightness and contrast adjustment
D) Use a more complex CNN model with more layers
questions.correct_answer_text: C) Use data augmentation techniques like random brightness and contrast adjustment
questions.explanation: Data augmentation techniques like random brightness and contrast adjustment can artificially increase the size of the dataset by generating new images with different lighting conditions. This can help the model to generalize better and improve its performance in low light conditions.
